notice: Public claim approvals only. Private implementation evidence and repository locations are intentionally excluded.

cloud-managed-path.summary: Veritio Cloud is an optional hosted product and the OSS SDKs remain usable without a hosted account.

cloud-projects-keys-ingest.summary: The managed product implements projects, scoped keys, and a project-scoped ingest path.

cloud-export-requests.summary: The managed product implements export requests, job status, and download surfaces; downloaded bundles still require explicit verification.

cloud-evidence-views.summary: The managed product implements tenant-scoped views for records, agent sessions, activity episodes, and governed changes.

cloud-identity-and-evidence-processing.summary: The managed product implements account authentication, organization membership, and tenant-scoped processing of customer-supplied evidence records.

cloud-security-controls.summary: The managed product implements authenticated sessions, tenant-scoped authorization, append-only hash-linked evidence with integrity checks, and audit records for sensitive control-plane actions.

cloud-provider-configuration.summary: The managed product is configured to use Cloudflare and Neon infrastructure; Polar is listed only as a planned payment processor until billing is activated.

cloud-price-catalog.summary: The reviewed pre-launch Cloud catalog defines six intended self-service products: monthly and yearly billing for Pro, Team, and Compliance, plus Enterprise contact sales. It publishes exact event, project, export, and hard-ingest limits; plan-based evidence retention is not yet available. Checkout and trial activation remain pending approved legal versions and operator production gates.
